basic_details.job_title: DPSRU Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pharmaceutical Science and Research University (DPSRU) is recruiting candidates for 3 Project Associate-II vacancies on a temporary basis. Eligible applicants can attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM at the Auditorium, DPSRU, Pushp Vihar, Sec III, New Delhi. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project for 06 months, extendable as per University norms. Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Pharmacy/natural or Agricultural Sciences/MSc. or Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy/ Engineering/ Technology/ medicine with 2 years experience, and

faq.question: Q1. When is the DPSRU Project Associate-II walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 09:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Auditorium, DPSRU, Pushp Vihar, Sec III, New Delhi-110017.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are UR-03 vacancies for the Project Associate-II post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's Degree in Pharmacy/natural or Agricultural Sciences/MSc. from a recognized university or equivalent, OR Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy/ Engineering/ Technology/ medicine form a recognized university or equivalent AND Two years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academics Institutions or Sciences and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on the date of application, with age relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What monthly emoluments are offered?
faq.answer: 42,000/- + HRA pm for candidate who have qualified National Eligibility Tests- GPAT, CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship); or GATE; or a selection process through national level examinations conducted by central Government Department their Agencies and Institutions. 33,000/- +HRA pm for candidates who do not fall under the above category.

faq.question: Q8. Is this job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary for 06 months, extendable as per University norms.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report with duly filled application form with attachments along with original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any prior shortlisting process?
faq.answer: No, the position will be filled through interview based selection (no prior shortlisting).
